content:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — NV driver Xid resets spike detected on infer-rt-pool (us-west-2). 6 resets/min across multiple nodes, starts 10:12 UTC. Auto-evacuate=false. thread=2294506789

dana: seeing elevated 500s from inference service around 10:13, correlates with driver resets. routing fallback fired for some requests :thinking_face:

ash: looking at grafana now — infer-rt-13 shows ECC corrected errors climbing, then a few Xid 79 entries in dmesg.

marta: grabbing dmesg + nvidia-smi logs from infer-rt-12..15, will paste snippets. please hold on any mass deploys.

chris: spun up customer bridge (ad-hoc) -> https://zoom.example/bridge/2294506789 — joining now. I'll ping CS for impacted customer list.

marta: paste: ```
[ 10.12.45 ] NVRM: Xid (PCI: 0000:af:00): 79, Channel ID 00000000
[ 10.12.46 ] NVRM: GPU at 00000000:af:00: GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 10.12.47 ] kernel: Driver timeout - resetting GPU
```

ryan: that Xid 79 pattern looks like driver/firmware level reset, maybe related to recent kernel module change from last week? any recent node kernel patches?

ash: no kernel updates in that pool since deploy on 03/02. but infra pushed a small runtime patch to the inference image yesterday (non-GPU). unlikely but worth noting.

dana: impact snapshot from ingress logs: ~4% of requests instantaneous errors, 2 customers with sustained failures (>5% p50 error rate). Will notify account owners.

chris: @customer-bridge-bot can you pop the customer list + contact emails?

customer-bridge-bot: Bridge created for incident 2294506789. Affected customers: acme-inc, beta-saas (contact owners: acme-support@, beta-pm@). Notifying now.

marta: quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon infer-rt-13, drain pods, 2) reprovision a clean node or move pods to infer-rt-21, 3) collect full logs & push to incident artifact store, 4) escalate to eng-runtime for driver investigation. Agree? :thumbsup:

ryan: agree. also recommend toggling fallback routing to route more traffic to dedicated non-GPU pool until we stabilize. Dana, can you change routing?

dana: doing a temporary route shift now (5 min TTL). monitoring latency.

marta: cordon+drain infer-rt-13 in progress: `kubectl cordon infer-rt-13 && kubectl drain infer-rt-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

marta: drain succeeded, pods moved. Node still reporting occasional Xid resets in dmesg (low frequency).

eng-runtime: assigned for driver deep-dive. pulling kernel debug symbols and vendor driver logs. tagging @ryan for kernel traces.

ryan: collecting /var/log/dmesg, /var/log/kern.log, and nvidia-bug-report.sh output. uploading to 
https://artifacts.internal/2294506789/runtime-logs.tar.gz

chris: on bridge — CS joined, provided workaround: small number of customers rerouted to hosted-host fallback. Customers notified of potential degraded quality; bridging with acme-inc now.

marta: quick post-mortem item: we saw ECC corrected errors ramp then Xid resets; possible hardware degradation on infer-rt-13. Recommend cordon persist until deeper hardware check. filing HW ticket.

customer-bridge-bot: acme-inc accepted workaround, wants weekly updates until resolved.

dana: rolling restart of inference service on infer-rt-12 completed, no further resets on that node. infer-rt-14 still shows occasional resets (2 in last 5m).

eng-runtime: preliminary hypothesis: memory ECC noise causing GPU lockups under specific seqlen+batch combos. reproducer in progress with micro-bench harness. If reproducer consistent, patch runtime to reduce concurrency on affected cards.

ryan: opened infra ticket INFRA-3247 to schedule physical check on infer-rt-13 (power cycle + run memtest).

chris: I created incident doc and linked outage summary in opswiki: https://ops.example/incidents/2294506789. Adding mitigation timeline.

marta: next actions: keep routing shift in place, continue draining suspect nodes, escalate to vendor support if HW checks show parity errors. I'll own follow-up and summary for handoff to morning oncall.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled at 06:00 PST. Incident status: degrading -> stabilized (traffic now at 98% routed, two nodes cordoned).

ryan: accepted. tagging @eng-runtime to follow with reproducer results in the morning.

chris: thanks all — updating customer bridge notes and will send formal customer update in 30m. :white_check_mark:
